findings.finding: Private account, analysis and result URL families can return 200 HTML.
findings.remediation: Emit X-Robots-Tag noindex, nofollow, noarchive centrally for every private prefix.
findings.test: tests/seo-phase-1.test.ts validates registry separation; production smoke checks response headers.

findings.finding: Canonical behavior and sitemap membership are not driven by one registry.
findings.remediation: Use the SEO registry as the source for editorial canonicals and sitemap URLs.
findings.test: Unique slugs, normalized canonicals and exclusion of private paths are deterministic.

findings.finding: Baseline topical coverage is concentrated in workflows and a small number of informational routes.
findings.remediation: Publish a 12-page Romanian cornerstone cluster with breadcrumbs, sources and internal links.
findings.test: Every page meets minimum content, FAQ, source and related-link requirements.

findings.finding: Structured data is global rather than page-specific.
findings.remediation: Emit Article, BreadcrumbList and FAQPage graphs only where the visible page content supports them.
findings.test: SSR smoke tests validate JSON-LD type and page title.

nonGoals: No recommendation-engine formula or numerical assumption changes.
